title: Origin story: Oya
description: Oya was the warrior wife of Shango, orisha of the winds and the Niger River, guardian of the cemetery gates. She commands the whirlwind and the lightning's edge, and leads the souls of the dead with her nine skirts of storm. Fierce and independent, she bows to no one.
